review_candidates.title: Senior Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer based in United States. This remote Senior Platform Engineer role focuses on building and operating secure, cloud-native production environments for complex technical and mission-critical applications. You will serve as a key bridge between application development teams and platform infrastructure, helping teams deliver reliable software efficiently and securely. The role combines Kubernetes engineering, infrastructure automation, cloud technologies, security, continuous delivery, and hands-on problem solving. You will contribute to platform architecture, automation, implementation, troubleshooting, and the development of reusable production capabilities. Working in an Agile and highly collaborative environment, you will also help guide less experienced engineers and promote strong engineering practices. This is an opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while supporting demanding environments where security, reliability, and operational excellence are essential. Accountabilities Build, automate, and maintain production runtime environments that support a range of application workloads. Act as the technical bridge between application development teams and platform environments, facilitating communication and promoting platform best practices. Validate technical solutions and implementations against defined requirements, ensuring platform integrity, reliability, and efficiency. Independently investigate and solve technical and business problems, developing focused components or solutions when needed. Translate medium-level technical tasks into cohesive platform capabilities and collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate components effectively. Estimate the time and effort required for technical tasks and contribute to planning and resource allocation. Apply programming and scripting appropriately to automate processes and solve infrastructure challenges. Support Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, continuous delivery, containers, and automation tooling. Contribute to security automation, monitoring, performance instrumentation, and secure architecture practices. Troubleshoot complex systems and read, write, and debug code as part of ongoing platform development and operations. Help establish and promote scalable DevOps and DevSecOps practices across application and platform teams. Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. Travel approximately 10–25% as required. Requirements Proven experience as a Platform Engineer or in a similar engineering role focused on system architecture, infrastructure, and development. Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies such as Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, and Docker. Familiarity with continuous delivery, distributed architectures, containerization, cloud services, infrastructure-as-code, and everything-as-code practices. Experience with tools and technologies such as Terraform or Pulumi, GitOps, Helm, Kustomize, and CNCF or open-source projects. Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Ansible, along with basic shell scripting knowledge. Strong proficiency with YAML. Understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps principles, including CI/CD theory and implementation. Experience working in an Agile framework within a remote or distributed team environment. Strong independent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging capabilities. Excellent communication and collaboration skills when working across application, platform, security, and other technical teams. Experience with security automation and familiarity with API security, container security, and cloud security. Knowledge of secure architecture design, monitoring, and performance instrumentation within complex enterprise environments. Ability to understand technical requirements and independently develop practical solutions without relying entirely on predefined architecture. Top Secret/SCI security clearance or eligibility to obtain the required clearance. DoD 8570 IAT II certification. Experience supporting Department of Defense environments, particularly production systems with an Authority to Operate (ATO). U.S. citizenship is required due to federal contract requirements. Benefits $148,750–$201,250 USD annual salary. Remote work within the United States. Medical, dental, and vision insurance with premiums 100% company paid. Health Savings Account (HSA). Life and disability insurance. 401(k) retirement plan. Company stock options. Home office budget. Flexible Time Off (FTO). Federal holidays plus additional company-wide holiday time around Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Paid parental leave. Reimbursement for approved training and professional subscriptions. Conference support, including travel, lodging, and registration fees. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Software, QA, Data & IT Talent Pool - Tana Fellowship Program
review_candidates.description: Launch your global tech career with Tana At Tana , we believe that your skills and your character define you, not where in the world you were born. We empower brilliant young people in Africa to start meaningful careers by training them for tech and data roles, and embedding them into full-time, remote positions with companies across North America and Europe. We're a rapidly growing start-up headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, with a vision to change the world of work. Position overview We are hiring early-career Kenyan tech talent for our Tana Talent Pool . If your application is successful, you’ll be actively considered for full-time remote roles with our global partner companies as part of the Tana Fellowship Program . The roles we most commonly hire for include: Junior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer Junior Technical Support Engineer Junior Data Analyst Junior Developer AI Business Analyst These roles are designed for recent graduates and early-career candidates who are serious about building global careers in technology. If matched with a partner company, you’ll complete pre-deployment training and then join the company full-time. You’ll work remotely, be embedded into a real global team, and have the opportunity to unlock long-term employment based on strong performance. Requirements Kenyan citizen based in Kenya. Completed university degree in STEM or a tech bootcamp program, or completed coursework and awaiting graduation. 0–2 years of experience in tech roles (including Internships or Attachments). Strong technical foundation and interest in at least one of the roles above. Strong communication skills and willingness to learn. Reliable laptop, internet connection, stable power, phone, and home workspace. Application process Joining Tana is a competitive, multi-stage process. The first step is an initial application involving learning and practical exercises, followed by: Online technical skills assessments Screening interview Admission to the Tana Talent Pool Company-specific assessments and interviews Being admitted to the Talent Pool means we will actively consider you for upcoming roles. Final selection depends on available opportunities and partner company requirements. Use the link to complete the application form for the Tana Fellowship Program.
